description: When cleaning up the wrongly-placed reMarkable file, saw 'Cole Estrate' already in /Meetings and assumed it was the file just uploaded. Did not verify the existing file was from a prior session. Deleted xAI-Cole-2026-06-24 from the only place it existed, then had to re-upload it.
correction: Before deleting any file on reMarkable, verify it is actually the file in question — check the name, not just the folder. An existing file with a similar name is not the same file.
systemic_fix: When cleaning up reMarkable files, always match on the exact filename. Never assume an existing file with a related name is the target.
